tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur las zhal gdams 'ga' zhig zur du bkol ba// ༈ /na mo gu ru we/ bka' drin 'khor med kha 'u pa/ /pha kun spang chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /khyod dad ldan slob mas skul ba'i ngor/ /sprang kho bo'i rtogs brjod tshig 'ga' smra/ /nga sngon chad dge ba'i 'phen shugs kyis/ /rten dal 'byor rdo rje'i lus mchog thob/ /rje tshad ldan bla mas rjes su bzung / /chos rdo rje theg pa'i yang snying thob/ /gnas ri khrod dben pa'i bas mtha' brten/ /lam rim pa gnyis la 'bad rtsol byas/ /nyams ban bun gyi snang ba ci yang shar/ /de sngon chad byung ba'i gleng gzhi yin/ /dus deng sang gi gnas lugs bshad pa na/ /gdon chos brgyad kyi 'byung pos snying la btab/ /zas skor zas kyi dug chus sheṃs paṃ smyosaṃ/ /sems snyom las kyi mal nas long dus med/ /don gnog chung gi khe nyen rtsi rtsi nas/ /dgra 'chi bdag gis sbar 'dzid byas kyi dogs/ /nga bsam bzhin du snying khong chu las grang / /de da lta'i rnam thar lhug pa yin/ /da tshe gzhug la re smon 'di ltar yod/ /don tshe 'di'i re ltos rgyang ste skyur/ /khong mgo nag mi yi khyu nas bud/ /gnas nges med kyi ri khrod stong pa ru/ /zas zhen med kyi rtsa dang ldum bu za/ /lam 'khrul med kyi rim gnyis rnal 'byor la/ /sems rtse gcig tu yengs med lhug par 'jog /rkyen gang shar gyi snang ba lam du khyer/ /dus 'chi ba nam yong gi dgug sdod byed/ /rje bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs de la byed/ /ma khams gsum 'gro ba'i drin lan 'jal/ /khyed dad ldan slob ma'i dkor sbyong yin/ /de thugs la zhog cig slob bu rnams/ /sems de la 'gro na de bzhin mdzod/ /sprang re smon 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rgyal khams pas rang gi tshe 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi rtogs brjod sems la shar ba/ sgro skur med par lhug par smras pa dge'o/

/bkra shis// ༈ //na mo gu ru we/ bka' drin 'khor med kha 'u pa/ /snying nas 'dud do gtsug gi rgyan du zhugs/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i rten 'brel ltad mo'i glu/ /grag stong nyams dbyangs thal lo bla ma rje/ /thugs rjes rgyang nas gzigs dang drin chen rdo ring pa/ /snying nas 'du 'bral med do pha rgod rdo rje 'chang / /spang gshong rgyu 'grul byed pa'i lha bya tsho/ /gshog 'gyur gsung snyan sgrog pa snang ba bde/ /nyi zer la la bzhud pa ma tshor ram/ /rang yul tshong sgo snyegs pa mi drag gam/ /don med wa skyas bzung na mi 'gyod dam/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thong dang lha bya gong mo tsho/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thong dang spu sdug gsung snyan tsho/ /na mnyam sems mthun rdeb pa'i gzhon nu tsho/ /glu dbyangs rtsed 'jo byed pa snang ba bde/ /grib so thang la bab pa ma tshor ram/ /shing thun rem nas sgrugs pa mi drag gam/ /drin can pha mas 'thab na mi 'gyod dam/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thong dang a ma'i gces phrug tsho/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thong dang na mnyam yid 'ong tsho/ /ri khrod dben par gnas pa'i bya bral ba/ /bag yang gcer nyal byed pa snang ba bde/ /'chi bdag bdud po yong ba ma shes sam/ /rtse gcig bsam gtan sgom pa mi drag gam/ /dal 'byor stong log byas na mi 'gyod dam/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thong dang rnal 'byor bya bral ba/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thong dang ri khrod sgom chen pa/ /snyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /mkhas grub tshad ldan bla mas rjes su bzung / /gdam ngag rgyud sde zab mo'i yang snying thob/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas byas pa mi drag gam/ /blo skyed gsha' ma gcig thon dang drin can bla ma'i sras/ /bsam mno legs po gcig thong dang rgyal khams bya bral ba/ /zhes pa 'di phan yul bya bzang gi ri khrod kyi brag kha zhig tu nyi ma dgong phyogs skyo sang byas pa'i tshe mdun gyi spang gshong la gong mo mang po rtse zhing /

rgyab kyi thang la phyugs rdzi mang po shing 'thu zhing rtsed mo byed pa mthong bas/ 'di dag kyang bsam na dge sbyor gyi bskul mar 'dug snyam nas/ rang sems la gsal 'debs su smras pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //kun khyab 'khor lo'i snying la bzhugs kyang kho bo'i gtsug nang ngur smrig 'dzin/ /gzhom med na da'i sgra dbyangs gcig pu bdag gi rna ba'i bcud len mkhan/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho khyod kyis sprul kyang 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon gcig pu nyid/ /kun spangs chos rjer snying nas 'dud do sprang po'i 'dod don 'grub par mdzod/ /rab dkar rdo rje 'dra ba'i snang brnyan na/ /gti mug dud 'gro'i rnam shes zhugs 'dra ba'i/ /'khor bar gtan 'khyam nus pa'i ban+de la/ /snying nas ma bzod rang gis skul ma 'debs/ /sngon bsags dge bas bsgrubs pa'i dal 'byor rten/ /khams gsum 'khor ba 'di na nyin dkar tsam/ /rnyed dka' don chen ldan pa thob gyur nas/ /stong log ngan 'gror 'gro ba khyod phod dam/ /khyod ni sngon chad yongs 'dzin mang po bsten/ /gdam ngag zab dgu ji snyed thob par rloms/ /blo gsal thar 'dod mang po'i slob dpon dang / /sdig can gson gshin mang po'i 'dren pa byas/ /dad zas gshin zas rgya mtshor longs spyod rol/ /de dag rnams kyi khur gyis non gyur nas/ /da ni nges par 'byung ba'i 'chi bdag dang / /'phrad tshe legs lam bde ba'i gdeng yod dam/ /rnam dag so thar sdom pa'i bcas pa dang / /rgya chen lhag bsam rab dkar byang sems dang / /zhi lhag zung 'brel mtha' bral lta ba dang / /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ting 'dzin ci yod soms/ /snyigs dus skye bos gleng la ci byar yod/ /sras bcas rgyal bas mkha' dbyings ma khrel zhing / /rang sems drang po dpang du btsugs pa yi/ /'gyur med dga' spro'i gdeng tshad yod na legs/ /de min tshe 'di'i ngo srung bzang rdzu dang / /dus gsum sgrigs pa'i mkhas 'dod kha bshad dang /

/rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /blun po'i 'dun sar mkhas grub 'khur zhes kyang / /'byung bzhi 'khrul pa'i nad kyis btab gyur cing / /lus sems 'bral ba'i mtha' la sleb pa na/ /lus ni bying zhing sems ni rtab rtob kyis/ /mo 'debs bon byed kun la skyabs gnas 'tshol/ /da lan 'di nas thar dus byung ba na/ /dam chos byed do snyam pa'i re smon 'debs/ /sngar gyi dad ldan rnams kyang zhe khrel byed/ /chos pa'i mal du phal pa'i phung po bzhag /de nas 'jigs rung bar do'i 'phrang du sleb/ /las rlung drag pos gtol med phyogs bcur khyer/ /mi bzad gshin rjes sha brtson bzhin du ded/ /'byung bzhi log pa'i 'phrul snang du mas dngangs/ /kyi hud de 'dra'i las la thug pa'i tshe/ /da lta rtse gcig sgom pa'i goms 'dris kyis/ /tshe 'dir brtan pa thob pa'i gdeng med na/ /go yul bzang rdzu'i chos kyis phan pa med/ /thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig ltung dang / /tshe 'dir mngon gyur mi dge'i bag chags kyis/ /thar 'dod ngan 'gro'i gnas su skyes gyur na/ /de la bzod pa'i go skabs ga la yod/ /mi bzod bzhin du bskal pa'i bar du myong / /gnas der dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra tsam yang / /mi thos mgon skyabs kun dang bral gyur nas/ /'khor bar gtan 'khyam byed pa'i gnas tshul la/ /bsams na bzod glags 'dug gam snying med po/ /tshe 'di yun thung yud tsam 'di nyid la/ /skyid kyang ma 'tsheng sdug kyang ma phung 'dug /yun ring gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub pa'i slad/ /ling ste skyur nas phyin na mi drag gam/ /che dgu kun gyi gtsug tu thod bzhin bskur/ /zas skom yid 'ong 'dod dgus mchod gyur kyang / /ngo srung phrag dog nga rgyal skye ba dang / /dkor nag dug chu sems rgyud nyams pa'i rgyu/ /sngon nas 'brel pa'i gnyen dang mdza' bshes kyis/ /gdung sems brtse bas 'phreng ba'i phyir chags kyang /

/nam phug nges par 'bral ba'i chos can la/ /de la brten pa'i chags sdang che dgu 'phel/ /sems mthun 'dzum dkar ston pa'i grogs dag kyang / /legs par brtags tshe bshang gci'i phung po 'dra/ /sha khrag 'dam gyis g.yogs pa'i skyes bu'i gzugs/ /rin chen gos kyis spras pa kho nar zad/ /zang zing g.yo ba'i nor rdzas 'byor gyur kyang / /gsog dang srung pa'i sdug bsngal du mas mnar/ /phal cher sbrang ma'i rtsi bzhin gzhan gyis spyod/ /'chi tshe nges par lag stong gcig pur 'gro/ /snyan grags 'dzam gling kun tu khyab gyur kyang / /ji ltar brag cha'i sgra bzhin grag tsam nas/ /stong pa'i skad kyi lhang lhang sgra skad la/ /chags shing zhen na de las 'khrul pa ci/ /snyigs dus da lta'i slob 'khor ji snyed kyang / /bka' blo mi bde dad chung rang 'dod che/ /bstan la mi phan rang don nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bdag gzhan phyogs rigs khong khro kho na'i rkyen/ /mtho na phrag dog mi snyan sna tshogs sgrog /dma' bar bsdad na brnyas bcos 'phrog bcom byed/ /mnyam la 'gran sems gnod 'tshe 'ba' zhig rgyu/ /chos pa'i gzugs kyis chos min kho nar spyod/ /sngar byon rgyal dang rgyal sras ji snyed kyis/ /'dul bar ma nus snyigs dus skye bo yi/ /khrod nas bdag nyid bse ru ji bzhin du/ /zla med gcig pur dben pa'i dga' 'tshal snyegs/ /'di na bye ma brdal ba'i sgang bu la/ /lan brgyar 'dzegs pa'i srog chags phra mo ltar/ /'bad pa che la 'bras bu chung ba yi/ /tshong las so nam dus bzhir 'bad pa 'phrul/ /'on kyang dbyar dus grog mo ji snyed kyis/ /grog 'khar phung po spung pa'i ngal dub la/ /ban bun za zir rgyu ba ji lta bar/ /bskal ngan las kyi dbang gi ci yang nus/ /blun po las ngan gsog pa'i snying rus tsam/ /shes ldan byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir nus na/ /lo zla tsam gyis sangs rgyas 'grub nges kyang / /phal cher 'dun pa tsam yang med pas 'phung /

/da ni tshe mjug dgong kha'i nyi zhur tsam/ /rlung la ma skur gros thag sbad kyis chod/ /bya btang blo gsal dben pa'i ri sul 'grims/ /mi med lung stong bsti gnas dam par bzung / /der ni 'khor yug sa 'dzin 'phreng bas skor/ /gnam sngon bai ḍūr+ya 'dra'i bla re bres/ /sprin dkar 'ja' tshon smug pa'i lda ldi dang / /gdugs 'phreng yid 'ong rgyal mtshan ji snyed pa/ /skabs 'gar sa phyogs de yi rgyan gyur snyam/ /ljon shing 'dab ma rgyas pa'i rlung yab kyis/ /rnal 'byor tsha gdung skyob pa'i grib bsil sbyin/ /rtsa sngon ched du bkram 'dra'i spang gshong dang / /'jam shing mtha' gru yangs pa'i rdo leb bkram/ /ha cang drang po min pa'i 'bab chu'i rgyun/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran pa'i brda ston du/ /shugs drag yud yud 'gro ba'i rlabs 'phreng g.yo/ /bag phebs dal 'gro'i ri dwags pho mo rnams/ /las kyi 'bras bu ched du ston pa'i slad/ /za nyal rtse ba 'ba' zhig lhur len cing / /res 'gar shugs ring 'khun bu dal gyis 'byin/ /le tshan gcig rdzogs so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur las zhal gdams 'ga' zhig zur du bkol ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
